summary: Elevate your career with our Executive and Personal Assistant Training. Gain essential skills to excel in high-demand roles and boost your professional growth.
lede: Executive assistant training gives people who support leaders practical methods for managing calendars, communication, and office workflows. Learners practise diary and priority control, prepare correspondence and meeting materials, coordinate travel and stakeholder needs, and maintain confidential records. The course also introduces AI-assisted drafting and digital workflows, with human review and discretion.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who support leaders directly and need practical methods for managing executive time, communication, and workflow with accuracy and discretion.
prerequisites: Participants should have basic office literacy, familiarity with email and calendar tools, and working knowledge of common productivity software such as Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, or Google Workspace. No coding or advanced technical background is required. Prior experience in administrative support, reception, office coordination, or executive assistance is helpful, and learners should be prepared to work with real office scenarios, templates, and short written exercises.
